description: A graduate student needs to convert 8 messy citations from mixed formats (MLA, incomplete entries, wrong capitalization) into proper APA 7th edition format. Open the document at /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/thesis_references.docx. Standardize all citations to APA format: fix author names to 'LastName, F. M.' format, convert article titles to sentence case, italicize book and journal titles, add missing DOIs (provided at bottom), fix punctuation, sort alphabetically by first author's last name, and apply hanging indents (0.5 inch). Save when complete (Ctrl+S).
